raw_response:
I am renting this small plot here in Mwanza, and cassava and sweet potato are what I know best. The land is not mine, so I will not spend money on chemical fertilizer — it is too expensive and I cannot be sure I will farm this plot next year. I will use cuttings from my last harvest and from my neighbor, and put some manure from the few animals we keep. The rains here are enough for tubers, so no irrigation, and pests are not a big problem for cassava. My wife and older children will help me with the weeding and harvesting.
